purpose: S072 off-shell projected boundary phase action, positive bath spectrum and quantum recoil

sources.reading_scope: Appendix A and A.1 reread in full. The electric center-of-mass boson, its Stueckelberg action and the distinction from remaining neutral/non-Abelian modes. The positive Euclidean convention is stated explicitly. No full angular WZW completion, boundary vertex normalization or 4D switching result is imported.

Sections 2 and 3.1--3.4 read, with 3.3--3.4 read separately in full after truncation. Oscillator environment Hamiltonian, phase insertion, Wick correlation, fluctuation-dissipation relation, energy-exchange first moment and detailed balance. Their equilibrium-reservoir and leading golden-rule assumptions are not adopted for the entangled time-dependent wormhole stress.

inherited_evidence.role: Constrained current action, half-line Dirichlet-to-Neumann bound, static normalization and prior conditional compact-state result. The present boundary variation, positive phase spectral completion and recoil calculation were not established by the earlier mean-response estimate.

novelty: Bosonization, Gaussian influence functionals and oscillator spectral methods are established. The RN boundary variation and quantitative comparisons are explicitly derived; no exhaustive novelty acceptance.
limitations: The background and projected current action are fixed-RN and quadratic
Winding weights and nonlinear compact angular dynamics remain undetermined
A finite-band electric oscillator factor is not the full renormalized fermion vertex
The exact one-mode counterexample shows that coherence bounds alone do not bound energy deposition
The actual smooth-switch stress, moving geometry, preparation and sufficient stability remain open
